finding.claim: UpyunCallbackAuth fails open: on upyun.ValidateCallback error it writes a 401 but never aborts, then calls c.Next(), so the upload-completion handler (ProcessCallback) still runs on an unsigned callback.
finding.source: Unauthenticated POST to /api/v4/callback/upyun/:sessionID/:key with an attacker-controlled body; attacker needs a valid sessionID and key (gated by UseUploadSession, not in this snapshot).
finding.sink: controllers.ProcessCallback -> callback.ProcessCallback(c) (routers/controllers/callback.go:18-19), which completes the upload session using the callback body.

trace.note: upyun.ValidateCallback returns err for an unsigned or forged request.
Writes 401 JSON with no c.Abort() and no return.
c.Next() runs unconditionally, invoking ProcessCallback (callback.go:17-31) which calls the service and returns 200.

finding.guards_checked: Signature verification (upyun.ValidateCallback): result is used only for logging and a response body, not to gate execution, so it is defeated. c.Abort(): missing on this path; present in sibling QiniuCallbackValidate (callback.go:43-44) and OSSCallbackValidate (callback.go:68-69, 75-76). UseUploadSession: middleware not present in the snapshot, UNCERTAIN; treated as a session-existence gate only. Impact on the service callback body validation (service/callback.ProcessCallback) is UNCERTAIN because that package is not in the snapshot.
